meme_name: Woh Stree Hai, Kuch Bhi Kar Sakti Hai
text: Woh Stree Hai, Kuch Bhi Kar Sakti Hai is a catchphrase and reaction image from the 2018 Indian comedy-horror film Stree , directed by Amar Kaushik and starring Pankaj Tripathi . The dialogue translates to, "She's a woman, she can do anything," and first went viral on Facebook in early 2019 before experiencing an annual resurgence on International Women's Day.

meme_name: Woh Stree Hai, Kuch Bhi Kar Sakti Hai
text: On August 31st, 2018, the Bollywood comedy-horror film Stree , meaning "Woman," was released. The film contained a scene where actor Pankaj Tripathi, playing the role of "Rudra," delivered the dialogue, "Woh street hai, much bhi kar sakti hai," which translates to, "she's a woman, she can do anything." The scene can be accessed via a May 17th, 2020 upload to Youtube [1] by Kaatil Boyz, where it gathered over 146,000 likes in two years (seen below). The earliest known use of the image and catchphrase was in a January 27th Facebook [2] post on the page Alia vs Pappu Jokes, where it gathered over 13,000 likes in over four years (seen below).

meme_name: Woh Stree Hai, Kuch Bhi Kar Sakti Hai
text: On January 31st, 2019, the Facebook [3] page Sociolik posted a meme using the catchphrase, gathering over 4,000 likes in nearly four years (seen below, left). On June 14th, 2019, the Facebook [4] page Sach Kadwa Hai posted another meme using the catchphrase, gathering over 12,000 likes in over three years (seen below, right). On August 22nd, 2019, the Facebook [5] page Idiotic Minds posted a wholesome meme using the catchphrase, gathering over 160,000 likes in over three years (seen below, left). On August 25th, the Facebook [6] page School Life = Unlimited Fun posted another meme using the phrase, gathering over 4,000 likes in over three years (seen below, right).
